The desktop shortcut shows the current logo again.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **No old tile behind the logo on Windows.** CannonCommander 1.0 showed its logo on a white tile, and a shortcut made back then could keep that picture through every update, because Windows held on to the icon it had once read from the program. Each new version now tells Windows once that the program changed, so the desktop shortcut, the Start menu and the taskbar show the logo with its frame and nothing behind it. An update of the copy installed for all users also brings the matching uninstaller, which otherwise stayed as old as the first installation. The icons are also drawn at each of their sizes from the logo itself, which keeps the frame and the cannons sharp down to 16 pixels, on Windows, macOS, in the tray and in the Flatpak.
